quests.title: Ten Cents, Forty Thousand Times
quests.blurb: Everyone at Lidcombe is changing trains to go somewhere and be paid. I stay here. Ten cents a container is not a business. Ten cents a container, forty thousand times, after a full house at the ground, is a business.

steps.label: find the Return and Earn behind Lidcombe station; it is full, it is always full
two coffees before five in the morning. one of them is hers and she will not say thank you
take the shuttle out to the ground at full time, with the trolley, against the crowd
photograph the concourse after the crowd goes: that is what forty thousand people leave behind
six boys are tipping the bins for the noise it makes. explain the unit economics to them
two hundred dollars. that is two thousand containers, or it is not, and she is not your father
bring the haul back to the trolley and let her count it

quests.title: Two Hundred Metres From a Fig
quests.blurb: I gave the council an undertaking. Two hundred metres from the tree, in writing, by consent. It says nothing at all about a telephoto lens. Go and count what they've cut, and don't wave at me on the way back.

steps.label: photograph the avenue at Jubilee Park -- the stumps and the ones still standing, in one frame
get the notice on the hoarding at the Glebe Point Road end, dates and all, before it gets turned to face the wall
four residents will film you filming and put it in the group chat; discourage all four
buy a flat white on Glebe Point Road so you read as a local rather than as evidence
the same arborist had the Petersham contract in March; catch the inner west line out and see it
photograph what he left at Petersham -- that is what precedent looks like
cross back round the bay and hand her the phone

quests.title: The Monday Shelf
quests.blurb: Forty-one umbrellas on Friday, a bare shelf on Monday, eleven weeks running. Norm wants it tested properly and he can't leave the window. Take the marked board somewhere else and be back before four.

steps.label: the Eveleigh gate on Wilson Street, where the trolleys park
two flat whites off the South Eveleigh cart, 5:40 am
one stop with the board, Redfern to Macdonaldtown
photograph the board where you leave it, time showing
five hi-vis blokes who all started this morning
cover the fares yourself; the window has no budget line
four o'clock at the window; tell Norm what's on the shelf

quests.title: Somebody Signed the Slab
quests.blurb: Forty metres, exposed aggregate, screeded till dark on Saturday. Sunday morning it's got three names, a handprint and a word I won't repeat cured into it. She won't pay. I've got a hearing date and a grinder.

steps.label: photograph the driveway for the tribunal — all three names and the hand
have a word with the signatories, who live in the units behind the job
photograph the Botanic Gardens: the blossom, the red bridge, the koi. Her reference image
the ute's blocked in by her Kluger — get the train to the trade counter at Granville
two flat whites. One for Serkan, one for the bloke holding the other end of the screed
the client is filming you from the nature strip for the review. Be in the review
get the progress payment out of it, one way or the other
show Serkan the slab and settle up on Auburn Road

quests.title: Eleven Days on Shirley Road
quests.blurb: Eleven days that Commodore's sat by the war memorial and the plate comes back stolen out of Hornsby. I'm not hooking up a stolen car with a booze bus at the bottom of the hill. Go and look at it for me.

steps.label: photograph the plate on the white Commodore
settle the four blokes sitting on their own bonnets
two flat whites, one for the constable on the bus
catch the North Shore line up to Hornsby
find the bay it was lifted from, top of the car park
$120 to cover the flatbed and Dobbo's morning
tell Dobbo what the plate actually came back as
